Hanno Eco-Tourism Association: https://hanno-tourism.jp/hanno-eco/tour/ec-shogakuji-akihuyu/

Join a practice experience centered on zazen meditation at Shogakuji, a Soto Zen–authorized meditation hall. You'll practice in Hanno's natural setting, listening to the sounds of the river, wind, and birdsong.

【Fee】¥7,000 per person (includes guide, lunch, sutra copying, insurance)

【Capacity】20 people

【Guide】Ishii Sanae (Shogakuji)

【What to bring】Towel, long pants suitable for zazen (wear them or bring them with you)
location: 集合 正覚寺 飯能市上名栗2326（国際興業バス「名郷」下車徒歩1分）
summary: Zen temple practice experience (zazen meditation, dharma talk, sutra copying, vegetarian cuisine, training)
